name: GradientArt · Orbs

title.zh: GradientArt · 从纹理模板查看渐变图层与代码

description.zh: Orbs原作品详情显示具体渐变、14层计数、部分图层和下载入口；未实际下载。 GradientArt 是可视化叠加 CSS 渐变的网页工具，附有纹理模板和作品详情。可从模板查看渐变图层与 HTML/CSS 下载入口，适合寻找网页背景的设计起点。
description.en: GradientArt is a visual CSS gradient tool with pattern templates and project detail pages. The observed templates and Orbs project show layered designs and HTML/CSS download controls; completed exports were not tested.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by GradientArt (https://gra.dient.art/).
Technology stack: css.
Component specification: Orbs原作品详情显示具体渐变、14层计数、部分图层和下载入口；未实际下载。

Visual details from source observation: 我们在首页看到的是 Carbon Fiber 编辑器宣传预览，并未现场调参。Templates 截图完整呈现四项纹理，底部还有两项局部；Orbs 详情可见光斑渐变、14 层计数与部分图层。它适合先挑纹理，再了解图层构成；本轮未执行下载、云端保存或登录。免费来自首页声明，编辑器源码及他人作品商用许可仍未知。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
